'''Conchflies''' are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are small bugs that craft shells of sharpened coral to drill through their prey.<ref> Conchfly [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Small bug that crafts a shell of sharpened coral. Spins its shell at rapid speed to cut through crust and bone."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Conchflies are flying enemies always found in pairs.<br>
They drill into the ground and walls and then launch back out of different surfaces at Hornet. If the tip of their pointy shell hits Hornet, they drill into her and Combo her for {{Damage|1+1}}.<br>

Contact with idle Conchflies deals {{Damage|1}}.

Though they only have melee attacks, Conchflies still attempt to keep their distance between attacks.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* The crust covers...
* The crust conceals...
* Our shells made strong...
* Our nest made secret...
}}

== Location ==
Conchflies can be found primarily in the [[Coral Tower]], but two can also be encountered next to a bench in [[Sands of Karak]], and they can be summoned by the [[Raging Conchfly]].
